contract.timing: Forty milliseconds of requested delays is nominal arithmetic only, not a completion or scheduling guarantee.

sourceMapping.backendFailureLimit: clock_gettime failure can return zero without a separate error flag. A zero prefix followed by positive readings may satisfy order and progress checks; the witness cannot prove a failure-free backend.

Source authentication, selected binary association, outer late-fault guard wiring, complete closure, output fit, native timing and semantic Clock acceptance remain separate gates.

memoryRetention.execution: Synthetic receipt JSON and pure functions only; no capture or lifecycle code executed.
memoryRetention.limits: Memory retention is not durable storage, challenge consumption, Clock acceptance or a substitute for the original boundary and late-fault guard. Trusted context provenance and ordinary caller assumptions remain.
